problems: Cliopatria's single Denmark-Norway row (1526-1940) is two states: denmark-norway (22 shapes, to January 1814) and the new slug kingdom-of-denmark-1814-1940 (8 shapes). Both list cliopatria_names ['Denmark-Norway'], so each prints 'has no verdict' warnings for the other's shapes (8 and 22), the convention used for other split rows.
Start year: the page dates the dual monarchy 1537; the dossier starts 1526 (Cliopatria; Kalmar Union row ends 1525) with the 1537 date as a rename event.
Wikidata Q62651 is shared with norway-denmark (1046-1055): different states, not merged.

Page budget exceeded: 16 distinct pages (budget 9 for 30 shapes; counted 9+1 for the 22 old shapes and 5+1 for the 8 later ones); Treaty of Kiel and List of Danish monarchs are shared by both dossiers. Four Lübeck/Thirty Years' War URLs failed before 'Treaty of Lübeck' loaded.

Cliopatria errors found: 1629-1631 Holstein/Jutland handed to Habsburg Monarchy (verdict wrong); Swedish Pomerania drawn Danish in 1814 (never held); Iceland kept to 1921 (sovereign 1 Dec 1918); rebel Schleswig-Holstein shape returns in 1853 (page: army disbanded 1 April 1851); 1626 Lower Saxon cells are a contest zone, not territory.

Counterparts used as Cliopatria carries the cells: holy-roman-empire-minor-states for the Gottorp part of Schleswig (1658, 1713-1720, 1773) and Oldenburg (1667-1773); swedish-empire for the 1611 Kalmar War pair; german-confederation (standing in for Prussia, whose row ends 1863) and austrian-empire for the 1864 cession; duchy-of-holstein for the 1848-1851 rebels. The Swedish, Habsburg, HRE-minor-states and Weimar dossiers should mirror the gains and losses listed in the notes.

Denmark proper 1940-1945 (occupation) is inside Cliopatria's Nazi Germany shape; the second dossier ends in April 1940 to match the row; a gap-filler should decide on a hatched occupation to 5 May 1945.
All events cite WebFetch pages; WebFetch returns summarised excerpts, so quotation marks in notes follow the excerpt wording; only the apostrophe-encoded URL for Northern Seven Years' War loaded.
